name: Elvira Riefenstahl
original_name: エルヴィラ・リーフェンシュタール
source: Protagonist's foster mother and the director of the Academy. She began the investment business at a very young age, but because all the work tired her out, she quit. Very loyal towards contributing to society and charity activities, she devotes herself to personnel training. Because she has been through life and death with the protagonist, they have a mutual trust for each other. Although sometimes she can suddenly become mischievous, she is a very kind and gentle mama.
